Gawler and Mike Stearman all of whom were to give the selectors some head aches when trying to find the best team for the approaching National Brighton Relay. The handicap was won by P.Childs(4.45) net time 26 mins. 43secs. with I.

Others to complete the course were Freddie Bradnum 53rd, Wally Wortley 61st and Alan Bishop 82. Ivor Edmonds started but was suffering from a rather badly swollen leg and decided to drop out at 9 miles.

Ivor Edmonds (Bristol A.C.) was favourite for the title with J.Heywood (H.H.H.) probable runner-up. At 5 miles Dabbs and Edmonds had a clear 44 secs. lead and a mile later were timed at 31.11 (this would have placed Chas. second in the Club 6!).
